messages.subject: Please post links to results on our wiki!
parts:
Dear students, thanks for all you hard work this summer! I hope you enjoyed your experience with R-GSOC!
Please post a link to your results on our wiki page in the status/results column, https://github.com/rstats-gsoc/gsoc2021/wiki/table-of-proposed-coding-projects

Dear mentors,
Now it is time to start thinking about projects for next year! Please post your ideas here, https://github.com/rstats-gsoc/gsoc2022/wiki/table%20of%20proposed%20coding%20projects
